name: Choosing Grout Color: The Decision People Regret Most
title-tag: Tile Grout Color Guide | Lynnwood, WA
meta-description: Grout color is the tile decision people regret most. Contrast vs blend, why white grout on floors goes grey, the sealing reality, and how to choose it right.
post-summary: December 22, 2026 · Grout is the cheapest line in a tile project and the one people regret most - it decides whether the floor reads as one surface or a grid of dirty rectangles. Blend vs contrast, why white floor grout goes grey and never comes back, what sealing actually does, and how to choose from a cured sample in your own light.
